follow-up time: Duration of hospital stay (mean: 17.9 days for hypothermic infants vs 10.9 days for normothermic infants)
cohort: Infants admitted to the neonatal unit at Steve Biko Academic Hospital from September 2019 to February 2020
finding: The incidence of hypothermia on admission was 66%, and hypothermia was associated with increased duration of respiratory support and longer length of hospital stay.
birth_weight: Birthweight <=1500 g was an independent risk factor for hypothermia
